name: Drip
tagline: Uses waste heat from AI compute to desalinate water in a custom membrane-distillation chamber.
problem: Data-center cooling consumes and wastes fresh water while AI demand grows; the team cites drought at home.
solution: A liquid-cooled Raspberry Pi 5 stands in for a data center running agent containers backed by a local Gemma server; its heat drives a custom membrane-distillation chamber, with live telemetry on a dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: the physical chamber, live telemetry readings and a data-center map simulation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Sustain The Spark” among 307 submissions.
Inverts AI's water cost: compute waste heat becomes the input for clean water.
A built chamber on the table makes the sustainability claim physical.

lessons: Answer the critique of your own technology by turning its waste into the resource.
